mapper.sql: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_PW, U.USER_NAME, U.USER_RANK, U.ORG_ID, U.COMPANY_ID, U.USER_PHONE, U.USER_PHONE2, U.USER_EMAIL, U.USED_YN, U.REG_DATE, U.UPDATED_AT, U.AUTH_ID, C.COMPANY_CODE, C.COMPANY_NAME, C.COMPANY_TYPE AS USER_TYPE, O.ORG_NAME, A.AUTH_DEFINE FROM TBL_USER_INFO U INNER JOIN TBL_COMPANY_INFO C ON U.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORG_INFO O ON U.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_AUTH_INFO A ON U.AUTH_ID = A.AUTH_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_USER_INFO (USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NAME, COMPANY_ID, ORG_ID, USER_PHONE, USER_PHONE2, AUTH_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userName}, #{companyId}, #{orgId}, #{userPhone}, #{userPhone2}, #{authId})
